First public release of **LVGLab**, a UI designer for **LVGL 8.3** on **ESP32 with TFT_eSPI**.

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (x64) | `LVGLab-0.1.0-windows-x64.zip` |
| Linux (x64, glibc 2.35+) | `LVGLab-0.1.0-linux-x64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `LVGLab-0.1.0-macos-arm64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Intel) | `LVGLab-0.1.0-macos-x64.tar.gz` |

Unpack and start `lvglab` (`lvglab.exe` on Windows). No installation is needed. Try the bundled example in `examples/showcase/showcase.lvglab`.

- **macOS:** the binary is not signed. If macOS refuses to open it, run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine lvglab` once in the unpacked folder.
- **Linux:** needs GTK 3 for the file dialogs (`libgtk-3-0`) and an X11 or Wayland desktop.
- Check downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

## Highlights

- All 36 LVGL 8.3 widgets with their properties, and the complete style property set per part and state
- WYSIWYG canvas with round display masking, moving and resizing, snapping and a grid
- Freely dockable panels: screens, layers, widgets, parameters, style, events, timeline, fonts and images
- Timeline: every change is a step you can jump back and forth to
- **SquareLine Studio import** (`.spj`, LVGL 8 projects), including the whole `assets` folder and the font definitions
- Export as a PlatformIO / Arduino **library**, with images converted to RGB565 and TTF fonts converted to LVGL bitmap fonts; the generated code is verified against LVGL 8.3.11
- English and German interface, light and dark mode, configurable editor preferences

## Known limitations

- SquareLine animations and events are not imported yet.
- The AI assistant is in the code base but not yet available in the editor.
- LVGL 9 is not supported.
